description.en: A clear view of your money: income, spending, assets, and the bigger picture.
description.zh: 从收入、支出到资产，用一个清晰的视角理解自己的财务。

source.description: Personal finance tracker for income, expenses, and assets with dashboards

subject.en: Copper and cream cow with complete horns, blue eyes, and a coral muzzle
subject.zh: 铜棕与奶油色奶牛，完整保留牛角、蓝眼睛和珊瑚鼻尖

description.en: The familiar face keeps both horns and ears clear. A short neck settles into a broad shoulder entering the lower-right frame, replacing the old internal bust cut.
description.zh: 熟悉的面孔保留完整牛角与耳朵，短颈自然连接宽厚肩部并从右下进入画框，替换原先画面内部的头像截断。

description.en: Broad copper and cream facets preserve the cow’s expression, coral nose, and blue eyes. This framing repair retains the existing accents without adding accessories.
description.zh: 大块铜棕和奶油色面保留奶牛表情、珊瑚鼻尖和蓝眼睛；这次修复构图，沿用原有点缀而不增加配饰。

description.en: The retained muted green field uses unequal stepped contours and softly lit edges. Its cool color contrasts the warm animal while the finance app theme remains separate.
description.zh: 沿用柔和绿色底面、高低不一的阶梯轮廓与细亮边，以冷暖对比衬托奶牛；财务应用主题色单独保留。

palette.source: Selected Noheir presentation, 2026-09-07-02/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The cream blaze, paired horns, and coral muzzle stay legible at 32 px. Smaller color planes merge at 16 px; transparent marks serve the sidebar and browser, while installed icons use the square presentation.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时，奶油额纹、双角与珊瑚鼻尖仍然清晰；16 像素时细小色面合并。侧栏和浏览器使用透明图，安装图标使用方形展示版本。

goal.en: Organize personal transactions, accounts and capital to review cash flow, allocation, returns and availability dates.
goal.zh: 整理个人收支、账户和存量资金，查看现金流、资金配置、收益与可用日期。

role.en: Web pages, Server Actions and MCP endpoints
role.zh: Web 页面、Server Actions 与 MCP 入口
业务 API 与 SQL 访问
财务记录与用户设置存储
供客户端授权访问的财务工具

role.en: Development, HTTP tests and Docker runtime
role.zh: 开发、HTTP 测试与 Docker 运行时

description.en: Broad terraced contours turn through unequal levels, echoing the calm breadth of the cow’s silhouette.
description.zh: 宽阔等高线沿不同层级缓缓转弯，呼应奶牛轮廓的稳重与从容。

alt.en: Copper and cream cow with complete horns, blue eyes, and a coral muzzle on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 铜棕与奶油色奶牛，完整保留牛角、蓝眼睛和珊瑚鼻尖，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Copper and cream cow with complete horns, blue eyes, and a coral muzzle.
description.zh: 铜棕与奶油色奶牛，完整保留牛角、蓝眼睛和珊瑚鼻尖。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥77px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 77px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
